item.title: What's your ideal game length for a standard AAA game?
item.author: invalid@example.com (entremet)
item.dc:creator: entremet
item.content:encoded: I think 40-60 hours is the sweet spot for me for AAA releases. There are some exceptions where I hit 100 hours on games, and it was all pure joy. The last game for me like that was Tears of the Kingdom. I think I clocked 120 hours on that bad boy. But usually, after 60 hours, I'm ready to peace out. That's one reason I mentioned I struggle with single-player DLC in a previous post. What about you?
